seo.title: OpenAPI YAML to TypeScript Interfaces — Private, Browser-Based Draft Tool | AafnaiPatro
seo.meta_description: Paste an OpenAPI 3.x YAML document to generate typed component declarations. Unsupported external references stop conversion.

requirements.runtime: browser, compiled via existing lazy route loader

input: textarea and optional file local read
limitations: This is a type generator, not a complete OpenAPI SDK; constraints such as minimum, pattern and format are not enforced at runtime.
